classification.difficultyReason: Direct application of the angle at the centre being twice the angle at the circumference on the same arc.

content.prompt: Find the values of the pronumerals.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre O, two leftward radii and two chords meeting at an upper circumference point. The unknown x is inside the angle between the chords. A short leader associates 100° with the central angle between the leftward radii. Source decorative colours are replaced by ordinary black geometry.
spec.mathematics: The central angle and x stand on the same arc between the two left circumference points. The central angle is 100°, so 2x = 100°.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the given 100° and unknown x appear in the question diagram; the printed source answer is retained solely in answer fields.

answer.worked:
The angle at the centre is twice the angle at the circumference standing on the same arc.
$$\begin{align*}2x&=100^\circ\\x&=50^\circ\end{align*}$$
